placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Strode Leisure Centre offers an indoor swimming option close to home for Clevedon families. A suitable public swim session can turn an ordinary afternoon into time spent moving and playing together.

Our family idea: choose a session that matches the least confident swimmer and keep your plans simple. Pack towels, swimwear and a change of clothes before you leave.

placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Check the pool timetable and book where required. Confirm child admission, adult-to-child ratios and swimming-aid rules with the centre.
